definitions.run: One prompt execution = (session, prompt_id, variant). All collector segments whose prompt_id tag matches (root dispatch, its resumes and every descendant agent) belong to the run.
definitions.variant: Parsed from the root dispatch description '<PID> <variant> run ...': v2 = re-run on the NEW install's dedicated agent; r2 = replicate (batch X, never dispatched); no token = v1.
definitions.install: old_install = session 4e2da3ce (installed ~/.claude lacking 19 corpus agents; fallbacks used); new_install = session fae82d02 (new install, dedicated agents present).
definitions.agent_type: Root agent type of the run; 'orchestrated' when the run has more than one distinct root agent type (P90).
definitions.fallback: 1 when the root agent_type is not among the prompt's target_agent alternatives ('X or Y', 'X (or Y)').
definitions.tokens_total: Sum over the run's segments of input + output + cache_creation + cache_read tokens (collector).
definitions.tool_calls: Sum of tool_use blocks over the run's segments (collector 'tool_calls').
definitions.turns: Sum of distinct API calls over the run's segments (collector 'turns').
definitions.duration_s: Elapsed wall clock of the run: max(segment end) - min(segment start), seconds (includes waits between resumes and children).
definitions.agent_wall_s: Sum of the segments' wall_s (agent-seconds, double-counts parallel children).
definitions.spawn_count: Sum of Agent tool calls made inside the run.
definitions.cost_usd: NOT RECORDED in any input (no price or cost column). Reported as missing; tokens are the only cost proxy. No price table is applied here because prices are external and unverified in this job.
definitions.grade: Grader verdict from grades.csv (T8a, 22 ids) + grades_T8b.csv (T8b, 18 ids): pass | partial | fail | tool-absent. Grades exist ONLY for old_install v1 runs. Any other run is 'ungraded'.
definitions.grade_rates: k/n with n = graded runs in the group (tool-absent INCLUDED in n); Wilson score 95 % interval. pass_rate_excl_tool_absent uses n = graded runs minus tool-absent.
definitions.quality_score: pass = 1, partial = 0.5, fail = 0, tool-absent = 0 (secondary; used only for descriptive Pareto points).
definitions.grader_reexecuted: 1 when the grade note says the grader re-ran or recomputed something (regex re-?ran|recomputed|reproduced|matches grader); grader_blocked = 1 when it says the re-run was blocked or not done.
definitions.final_status: STATUS value of the run's final report (last-ending root segment), collector regex '^\W*STATUS:\s*(done|partial|blocked)' case-insensitive; 'none' = no STATUS line.
definitions.status_line_strict: Final report has a line starting (after non-word chars such as ``` or **) with upper-case 'STATUS:' followed by done|partial|blocked.
definitions.status_block_complete: status_line_strict AND lines starting with upper-case RESULT, EVIDENCE and FILES (NEXT optional).
definitions.clean_header: First non-empty line matches '<input> · <YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM]> · <agent type>' (U+00B7 separators), the clean-finish header of the current rules (dot-claude/rules/claude-agent-stack.md, added in commit 18b8da1 on 2026-10-02 14:22 +0100; whether the OLD install carried it is unverified).
definitions.format_class: status_block (strict STATUS line, no header) | clean_header (header, no STATUS line) | both | neither | missing (no final report file).
definitions.compliant_current_rule: format_class == clean_header, or format_class == status_block with status_block_complete.
definitions.deviations: Per-run list: neither_format, both_formats, status_block_incomplete(missing fields), header_agent_mismatch, header_template_literal ('<input:' copied), header_input_over_10_words, fallback_agent.
definitions.overclaim: Graded run whose final_status is done (or clean_header) but grade is partial|fail|tool-absent.
definitions.underclaim: Graded run whose final_status is partial|blocked but grade is pass.
definitions.quantiles: numpy.percentile method 'linear' (Hyndman-Fan type 7). IQR = q75 - q25; p90 = 90th percentile.
definitions.bootstrap: Percentile bootstrap, B = 10000, resampling runs with replacement within the group; CI for mean and median; only when n >= 5.
definitions.pareto: Descriptive only. A point is non-dominated if no other point is at least as good on every objective and strictly better on one. Objectives: minimise median tokens_total, maximise pass rate (2-D); plus minimise median duration_s (3-D). Agent-type points are confounded by task mix; no design recommendation is made.
definitions.overhead: Root dispatches whose description starts with T<digits>[letter] (grading, collection) inside the campaign window; excluded from every run statistic.

exclusions.non_campaign_agents: collector kind 'other' rows (other jobs in the same sessions) are excluded
exclusions.open_segments: runs with open segments would be flagged; none at freeze time

never_run_held.P01: blackcat target; needs a fresh main session
never_run_held.P02: blackcat target; needs a fresh main session
never_run_held.P89: MLX benchmark, must run alone; not dispatched before STOP

data_gaps.replicates_r2: batch X never dispatched: no within-prompt replicate exists
data_gaps.grades_new_install: T8c/T8x never dispatched: no new_install run is graded

confounds.text: old_install runs used fallback agents for 19 missing types; new_install runs used dedicated agents, a newer stack and possibly other models. v1-vs-v2 differences mix all of these.

Graders marked 'tool-absent' when the sandbox or machine lacked a toolchain (Miri, Gradle/kotlinc, Hackage, Julia registry). These are environment failures, kept in the grade denominator; pass_rate_excl_tool_absent is reported alongside.
The read-only guard often blocked the grader from re-running tests; many grades rest on the agent's own evidence (see grades.grader_blocked / grader_reexecuted).

Verified example: P18 graded pass because 'exit 2 and permissionDecision deny both correct per hooks doc', while P23 graded partial because the hook used 'deny JSON with exit 0, not exit 2 as rubric says' (grades.csv vs grades_T8b.csv). P11 partial hinges on rubric intent ('return str(x+1)'). One grader per batch, no inter-rater check.
Most agent types have 1-3 runs; one run per prompt; no replicates. Wilson intervals are wide and bootstrap CIs are omitted below n=5.

The clean-finish header rule entered the repo at 18b8da1 (2026-10-02 14:22 +0100); whether the old install carried it is unverified, so old_install format compliance is also given under the legacy STATUS-only convention.
Prompt order, batching and concurrency were not randomised; S/M/L classes were run in waves; the graded population is old_install v1 only (40 runs).
Root models differ between installs (see provenance.*.runs_by_root_model): the agent definitions pin models per agent type, so install, agent type and model change together.
With pass/partial/fail grades the run-level cost-quality front collapses to the cheapest passing run (and any cheaper non-passing run); it says nothing about which design is better.
tokens_total counts cache reads at full weight; tokens_fresh excludes them. Neither is a cost; cost is missing.

pareto_points.population: old_install v1 graded runs (the only graded population)
pareto_points.caveat: Points mix different prompts and task classes; agent types were assigned by prompt, not randomised; n per agent type is 1-13. Descriptive only.

paired_v1_v2.definition: Prompts run as old_install v1 AND new_install v2. Differences confound agent type (fallback -> dedicated), install/config, model and time; NOT replicates.

tokens_total.note: log2(v2/v1); median 1.0 = v2 used twice as much

tokens_fresh.note: log2(v2/v1); median 1.0 = v2 used twice as much

tool_calls.note: log2(v2/v1); median 1.0 = v2 used twice as much

turns.note: log2(v2/v1); median 1.0 = v2 used twice as much

duration_s.note: log2(v2/v1); median 1.0 = v2 used twice as much

replicates.definition: Within-prompt variance needs >= 2 runs of the same prompt on the same install and variant (r2 replicates).
